    jarlskogℂCKM V = jarlskogℂCKM U := by
  obtain ⟨a, b, c, e, f, g, h⟩ := h

  simp only [exp_add, Fin.isValue, _root_.map_mul, ← exp_conj, conj_ofReal, conj_I, mul_neg,

  have hb : cexp (↑b * I) ≠ 0 := exp_ne_zero _
  have hf : cexp (↑f * I) ≠ 0 := exp_ne_zero _
